statement: `pyxis` is the product face and the acquisition owner. Verbs: `init` (§3.5), `converge`/`repair` (one converge; repair is its name on a damaged tree), `doctor` (read-only), `exec` (the grammar below), plus `version`. Every installed-repo invocation of an engine tool is `pyxis exec <tool> -- <argv…>`:
